sentences.text: 2. Sundar Choudhary S/o Dhanraj Choudhary, Aged About  28 Years, R/o Near Power House, Dhariyawad, District  Pratapgarh.
----Petitioners  Versus 1. The State Of Rajasthan, Through Public Prosecutor 2.

Bhanwar Lal Sharma S/o Badri Lal, Aged About 25 Years,
 Bhampuri, Dhariyawad, District Pratapgarh.
 ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Gajendra Panwar For Respondent No.1 : Mr. Mahipal Bishnoi, P.P.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE FARJAND ALI Order 16/04/2024 1.

The instant criminal misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been preferred by the petitioners for quashing of FIR No.167/2023 dated 16.05.2023 of Police Station Dhariyawad,
District Pratapgarh for the offences under Sections 420, 406 and 120-B of IPC.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners prays for quashing the aforementioned FIR and all further proceedings in pursuant thereof.
3. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the submission of learned counsel for the petitioners for quashing of the FIR and all further proceedings in pursuant thereof.

[2024:RJ-JD:16564] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-4165/2023]
Rekha vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:16564) on 16 April, 2024

4. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the niceties of the matter, it is felt appropriate to direct that the petitioners shall not be arrested during the entire course of investigation.
Instead thereof, if offence is found proved, then the Investigating Officer shall inform the petitioners to appear before the trial Court on the date of filing of charge-sheet.

5. On the day of filing of the charge-sheet and upon the appearance of the petitioners, they shall move a regular bail application under Section 437 of the Cr.P.C. and whereupon the learned trial Court shall release them on bail on the very same day; on the amount of surety and bond as it deems fit.
6.
Accordingly, the instant criminal misc. petition as well as the stay petition are disposed of.

(FARJAND ALI),J Abhishek Kumar S.No.366 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
